Ass-a n wussan, yeḍḥa-d umendil azwaw ansayan yuqa (ixus) deg Tmurt Tazwawt. Tuget n tḥuna uɣur ara terzuḍ ad t-tnadiḍ ad ak-d-inin: Ur nesɛi ara. D ayen i d-ittḥettimen asteqsi amek armi yuqa ɣur-neɣ umendil-a i iṭṭafaren timelsi tansayant n tmeṭṭut Tazwawt? Ula d tinaẓurin i ten-yettebrudin s ufus, ur caḍent ara akken ad teqwu sselɛa. Ilaq ad d-nini aṭas n tsebbiwin i yellan deffir waddad-a. Yiwet d akcam n lximar d lḥiǧab ɣer yidles-nneɣ d ttexmam n kra n Teqbayliyin. Tis snat d lexsas akked teɣlayt n umendil deg ulzuz. Imi ulac afares s waṭas, yezga umendil azwaw yewɛer i tifin, rnu ɣlay maḍi ma nga aserwes akked lximar d lḥiǧab iɣef i d-nemmeslay yakan.
Ahat ula d imsenza n yiselsa ɣef ssuma-s daɣen i ur t-id-ttawin ad t-senzen. Ma yella d tazmert tasertant ara d-yekfen afus i uselḥu di ssuq, ulac-it di Tmurt Tazwawt. Ɣef ssuma n umendil ansayan dɣa, ad d-nesmekti d akken yella wanida yettaweḍ ɣer 1 800 n yidinaren, ɣef leḥsab n tɣara d ssenf. Llan wiyeḍ d timḥermin kan, xeddmen 400 armi d 600 n yidinaren. Rnu, mačči aṭas n lesnaf d tɣawsiwin i nezmer ad naf di tḥuna-a. D acu, llan wid yettwalin ur ɣlayen yimendilen-a mi ara twaliḍ imecwaren akk ansi d-ɛeddan send ad amden. Akkin i waya, yewwi-d ad d-nini ur tuqa tqendurt am umendil deg ulzuz.
Mazal ttaɣent-tt Tezwawin ɣas ulamma llant tid i ittɛeddayen ɣef wazal d wansay mi ara as-rnunt lḥiǧab s ufella. Nesteqsa kra n Yizwawen ɣef taluft-a, fkan-d tamuɣli-nsen. « D tidet, ula d axus i ixuss umendil di ssuq yettaǧǧa aṭas n tlawin ad rrent ɣer lximar, tugart imi yerxes. Nekk s timmad-iw xḍiɣ i lḥiǧab n yinselmen, maca ur ttafeɣ amendil i walmend ad t-ttcudduɣ ɣas tikwal », i d-tenna yiwet n teḥdayt. « Ɣur-i tewweḍ taluft ɣer tizi n layas. Ma yella uqan yimendilen, ma yella ur ten-nettwali ɣur Teqbayliyin, lmeɛna-s yuɣ-itent yidles. Ilaq ad ten-id-nerr caḍen, ad ten-id-nettaɣ s waṭas ma nebɣa ad neṭṭef deg yiman d wayla », i d-yenna yiwen n umezdaɣ n Bgayet.
M. Azwaw

Timlilit n usirem n Yiɣallen n Ubeddel Amagday.
Iɣallen n ubeddel amagday sbedden arkawal asertan i usaka amagday n tidet. Mlalen yiɛeggalen n yikabaren n tsertit yal wa s ugensas-is: Hakim Beleɛsel Tirni n yiɣallen inemlayen (FFS) Muḥsin Bellabas Agraw i Yidles d Tugdut (RCD), akabar nYixeddamen (PT), akabar Anemlay n Yixeddamen (PST), Tadukli i usnifel d ufara (UCP), Amussu Amagday Ametti (MDS), Akabar i Talakt d Tugdut( PLD). Yella-d dɣa daɣen unermes si tazwara akked Muqqran Ait Lɛerbi, Lexder Buregɛa, Ǧamal Zenati, Saɛid Xellil, agensas n uzday Azzayri n yizerfan n umdan d waṭas n wudmawen n tsertit di tmurt. Tugnawin d wudmawen isertanen d yigensasen n tmetti taɣarimt yesmeɣnisen ɣef tnaya taɣerfant d ubeddel amagday, igensasen n ssandikat, igensasen n umussu n tdukliwin. Ugar n 80 n yimezdiyen i yedduklen deg yiwen n wagraw umi semman : “ Iɣallen n Ubeddel Amagday”.
Mlalen di Lezzayer tamaneɣt deg yixxamen n yikabaren. Adabu yugi ad asen-d-yefk turagt ad xedmen timlilit-nsen deg walbeɛḍ n tzeqwa di tmaneɣt. Ɣef waya lqaɛa n rebbi wessiɛet, idigan ur uqan ara, ihi timliliyin mmugent akken iwata. Imezdiyen wa deffir wa di tudma n wawal n yal yiwen, zzulen-d merra-nsen, snemren-d agdud ɣef uɛewwel-is i treṣṣi n ubeddel agejdan n unagraw anesdabu ɣef waẓar-is. Imedrawen neɣ imezdiyen n temliliyin luɛan-d i usmenyef d tixutert i tɣimit s wudem aɛafi d tdukli d tɣelnawt n tnekra taɣerfant, i yeswi n tṛessi n ufaris n usebdedd anayi ara yedmen isuram n ugdud Azzayri. I lmend n waya i d-nnan dakken tuddsa n tefranin tiselwayin deg tallit-a akked unagraw-a ameggafsu, atan d asider kan ara t-yessider. Rnu ad as-yefk tagnit akken ara yernu ad iheggi iman-is s wudem amaynut i tuɣalin-is.
Tamurt teqqim aṭas n wayyuren mebla aselway n tigduda. Yella unabaḍ uɛḍil, maca yeɣunzat ugdud. Sdat n waya d aqerru n tredsa i yeṭṭfen ṣrima, rnu yedmen amḍiq-nsen. Tuɣ ya tamurt-nneɣ werǧin tella gar yifasen n uɣarim. Sdat n tnekra tameqqrant n ugdud, adabu mazal-it kan akked txidas-is. Yessenfar kan amek ara yerreẓ amussu agdudan. Yettɣil s waya ara yegdel kra n usnifel asertan n tidet ara d-yawin abeddel amagday agejdan iɣef wacu ara tbedd tigduda tamaynut. Ass-a nettwali belli adabu n tidet ata mazalit kan gar yifasen n tredsa yerran ad tegdel kra yellan; Annayen, timesbaniyin, tikliwin…rtg. Sdat n taɣert uqerru-a, imezdiyen fɣen-d s wulɣu dakken astag ur d-yettili war:
-Aselluli amiran n yinekraf n tsertit d turdiwin.
-Aselluli n wennar n tsertit d tɣamsa.
-Aḥebbus amiran n tuṭfiwin d waggaz mgal iɣarmanen d yimeɣnasen n yikabaren, n ssandikat, iɛeggalen n umussu n tdukliwin, imeɣnasen n yizerfan n umdan , ineɣmasen.
– Aḥebbus amiran n uḥwaṣ n tbuɣar n tmurt d tririt n kra n wayen yettwakren.
Aya ad d-yili s tuddsa n tallit n usaka ara d-ijemɛen ttawilat isertanen i tenfalit tanayit n tidet n ugdud i tmeṣkiwt d usali n uwanek azerfan ara d-iṛessun ɣef:
-Timunent n teɣdemt.
-Beṭṭu d umnekni n yiduba.
-Ala i usemres n wasɣan d tgemmi, d yizamulen n waɣlan deg tsertit.
-Tagada deg yizerfan gar urgaz d tmeṭṭut.
-Ala i usemres n tekṛiḍt deg taslakt ɣef udabu.
-Azref i tdukliwin, azref i tuddsa n ssandikat.
-Azref i temliliyin, d tuddsiwin, d tmesbaniyin d tmeskanin.
-Anefru d ṭmana n uwanek ɣef yizerfan imettiyen , idamsiwen, imenzayen n yiɣarmanen.
-Tiṛessi n tlelliyin tisemdanin d tmazdayin, ssandikat d uzref n tagant.
-Tanaya taɣerfant ɣef tbuɣar tigmawiyin n tmurt.
-Tiṛessi n temlilt n uwanek deg gemmu aɣelnaw d uḥareb mgal tinmegliyin tidamsiwin d tmuɣbent. Aqaḍer n yal timagutin.
S waya kan ihi imezdiyen n temlilit ɛewlen-d ad qedcen deg ukatar n tdukli ara yeldin tiwwura i yal iɣallen yettnadin ɣef ubeddel amagday ara yessiwḍen agdud ad d-yerr tanaya-s. Yal tagara n temliliyin tfakant s usirem d ameqqran i tufɣa seg tezɣent. Imezdiyen fkan asihar ar temliliyin-nniḍen ara d-yilin deg ussan i d-iteddun.
Karim Sɛawi.

Aqrur aqvayli, am arrac ak umaḍal ittnekker-ed gar at uxxam, ilemmed tamusni is-ttaken imawlan d watmaten. Tameslayt ines d tin n tyemmatt, idles ines d win n tmurt ines. Tudart ines tveddu di taddart. Mi ivda ittaki d yiman is, iteffeγ ar verra itturar d ndud-is, ilemmed daγen tudart d wiyiḍ. Ilemmed tikli-s, ddac aâqac, i wiyiḍ imi myal yiwen γur-es tugna ines. Maca ayen iten isduklen ak, ayen iten irrran d arrac iqvayliyen d idles isen slemden imawlan d at taddart nsen. Akka ihi, kra d-illan illa-d s tmeslayt n vavat nsen d yemmat nsen. Simmal ttimγuren simmal lemden, simmal lemden simmal mmden.
Imawlan ttheggin tarwa s wawal γef lakul. Ttemslayen asen fell as akken ass-mi ara d-yaweḍ wass ur ttagaden ara, ur ttkukrun ara. Diγen netta gar wawal d wayeḍ, d aweṣṣi d tumla ivardan iwalan lhan i tarwa. Refden awal γef imal d tixxutert n leqraya. Imedyaten n wid ur neγri d wamek tuâer tudart fell asen uqan imi ṭaqa deg imezdaγ idurar akka i teḍra yid-sen. Nutni asirem nsen ak atan sarsent γef tarwa akken tsellek iman-is u ad tidir tudart nniḍen, tudart fessusen. Netta anect agi d nnya imi di tmurt n Llezzayer illan, gar wAâraven iḥeslen. Lakul ines ur d-ittawi tamusni ur isifsus tudart γef win t ikecmen.
Mi ewweḍ uqrur 6 iseggassen di ticett is, aqerruy iccur d tirga d umaynut γef lakul. Imawlan aten tafeḍ am arrac daγen ḥaren ak, tteḥriṭiwen ak sya-u-sya. Taâravt daγen snen-as tikli ama d tira-s d leqraya-s ama d ameslay-is. Idles aârav s umata yuγal iṭṭef aḥric ameqran di tmussni nsen. El Buḥturi snent amzun n taddart nsen ma Lvacir Amellaḥ, Ssi Muḥ Umḥand, velâid At Aâli, dda Lmu ur sellen yisen. Amzun d nutni i d iverraniyen, i d imzuγen.

D amedya, γur sen Llezzayer tevda ass-mi d-kecmen nutni, ass-mi akken iγ d-ewwin « tafat » n tneslemt. Imi d nutni i iḥekmen amek ara tawteḍ deg sen. Ar tama umezruy, illa yidles aârav d-yussan seg usammer. Ur qqimen imusnawen, imyaruyen, imedyazen d wid ak i γef icfa umezruy nsen. Idles nneγ ad tefren ad t γebbin amzun macci deg uxxam is i illa. Amek ara nmenni azarug, neγ timmument i tmurt nneγ d tarwa uzekka ara tettuγal d taâravt cwiṭ cwiṭ di myal ass tekka di lakul? Amek ara inadi azekka γef iẓuran is win isnen El Buḥturi ur issin dda Lmu? Tiririt ak i iseqsiyen agi ur fessuset ara. Acku tiririt nsen attan di taluft n tsartit imi ala azarug ara iselken tarwa nneγ seg udles aârav imi di tmurt nneγ ad nsγer amezruy d udles nneγ, am nekni am tmura. Wisen imahat kra n yiwen wass…
Ma d tura ssarmeγ kan imawalan d at taddart s umata, ad melsyaen i warrac tidett akken ur ttamnen ara ak ayen ara asen sseγren di lakul n Llezzayer aârav.
